get_execution_backend: get an execution backend instance by mode string or ExecutionMode enum for model inference
maybe_update_settings_backend: update inference settings to use UMAS_FAST_GPU backend if model config and settings allow it
ExecutionBackend_node_to_edge_wigner_per: gather node features and rotate L to M using Wigner matrices for edge messages
ExecutionBackend_permute_wigner_inv_edge: rotate edge messages M to L and scatter accumulated embeddings back to destination nodes
ExecutionBackend_edge_degree_scatter: rotate radial MLP output with Wigner inverse and scatter edge degree embeddings to nodes
